ائتمرن (form VIII)
# اِئْتَمَرْنَ (iʔtamarna) /iʔ.ta.mar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِئْتَمَرَ (iʔtamara)
# اِئْتَمِرْنَ (iʔtamirna) /iʔ.ta.mir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِئْتَمَرَ (iʔtamara)
